# Litefin v2.0.150 — Game Center, Enhanced Details & Russian Localization

## Highlights

- Added the native **Achievement Badges Game Center**, bringing achievement progress, badge categories, quests, ranks, rewards and power-ups into Litefin.
- Added native achievement-unlocked notifications, including localized messages and playback-mute awareness.
- Expanded **Enhanced Details** with release dates, award badges and additional cast facts such as age and birthplace.
- Added Enhanced metadata tags directly to native poster artwork across home, Continue Watching and related rows, with safer lazy-loading and fallback behavior.
- Significantly expanded Russian localization for Achievement Badges: page labels, badge names and descriptions, categories, quests, ranks, shop items, notifications and dynamic server-provided quest descriptions.

## Interface & Usability

- Refined the details metadata layout: release-date chips stay compact and at the end of the metadata line.
- Restored native Jellyfin rating indicators in the top metadata while keeping MDBList provider ratings in their own row below technical information.
- Improved award-list keyboard focus and scrolling, including lists containing more than five entries.
- Refined person cards so additional actor facts sit at the bottom and age labels remain compact.
- Improved poster-tag loading and visibility in home and Continue Watching cards.
- Added a local preview and a test action for Achievement Badges notifications.

## Fixes & Platform Improvements

- Fixed several poster-tag fallback and lazy-loading edge cases.
- Improved keyboard navigation and focus behavior for award lists and enhanced details.
- Improved webOS launch deep-link handling and startup capability reporting.
- Improved startup prefetch timing and CSS initialization to reduce avoidable work during launch.
- Fixed webOS audio being interrupted when changing playback speed.
- Included upstream fixes for custom headers, sidebar positioning, Seerr navigation and platform-specific scrolling.

## Notes

- This is a stable release built from the `feature/game-center-notifications` branch.
- Smart TV packages are provided in the supported Tizen and webOS build tiers. Desktop and Android packages are built by the separate Tauri release workflow.
